title: A dearer part selling for less than the range before it does not warn
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 with Default on Markup % 50 and from $100.01 with Default on Markup % 10.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 100.01 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Default's 50% markup and 10% markup values show no warning icon.
  • Both values show in the grid as "50% markup" and "10% markup".
  • The simulator at $100.00 shows Default $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00).

Step 3:

  • Default now reads $110.01 ($100.01 × 1.10 = $110.011, rounded to $110.01): less than $150.00, but above the $100.01 cost.
  • The grid's values still show no warning icon.
  • The 10% markup value is still shown.
